display.title: Kislev, Month of Miracles: Sign Up for Hashem's Army
display.summary_short: In Kislev, the month of miracles, Uncle Yossi calls on every Jewish child, even a newborn baby, to be signed up as a soldier in Tzivos Hashem, armed with Torah and mitzvos.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, given in Kislev of 5751, the year of wonders. Uncle Yossi explains that Kislev is the month of great miracles, and that this year we hope to see the miracles that end the golus and bring Moshiach, who will return us all to Eretz Yisroel. To be ready, we must do the good deeds that bring him sooner, and that is what Tzivos Hashem is about: giving Hashem an army of Jewish children whose weapons are Torah and mitzvos. Since Moshiach's coming is so close, children should sign up as many boys and girls as possible. It is never too early: as soon as a baby is born and named, he or she can be enlisted, and every soldier receives Hashem's blessing of protection and success in all their missions.
display.lesson: Every Jewish child, from birth, can be a soldier in Hashem's army, and Torah and mitzvos are the weapons that bring Moshiach.
